caption: The drawing features two distinct objects placed on an off-white or light beige background. On the left side, there is a depiction of a decorative vase with a round, bulbous base that tapers into a narrower neck and flares out into a ruffled rim. The vase is primarily white, with a faint pink hue visible along the neck. The ruffled rim is highlighted in yellow and adorned with small pink circular accents along its edge. Attached to the front of the vase, there are two red cherries with yellow stems and leaves, which curve around the body of the vase. To the right of the vase is a circular, flower-shaped object with a scalloped edge, rendered in yellow, and a concentric interior made up of a pink scalloped band surrounding a darker pink-red center. The overall composition is simple, with the two objects centrally placed, and there is a signature reading "MARIE FAMULARO 10-20-1936" in the bottom right corner.
title: Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
